blocks.text: Replit 是首个在云端实现 agentic 编程的平台。随着 agent 能力不断增强，我们的重心正从单一的编程 agent 扩展到能够完成现代软件工程团队所能做的一切、甚至更多的自主软件团队。

inlines.text: Replit 是首个在云端实现 agentic 编程的平台。随着 agent 能力不断增强，我们的重心正从单一的编程 agent 扩展到

blocks.text: 我们相信，软件的未来是由多个 agent 组成的团队协同工作，来构建、维护、保护和优化软件，而创作者设定方向并保持掌控。

blocks.text: Toward Autonomous Software Teams

inlines.text: Toward Autonomous Software Teams

blocks.text: Replit was the first platform to enable agentic coding in the cloud. As agents become more capable, our focus is expanding from a single coding agent to autonomous software teams that can accomplish anything a modern software engineering team can do, and more.

inlines.text: Replit was the first platform to enable agentic coding in the cloud. As agents become more capable, our focus is expanding from a single coding agent to
autonomous software teams that can accomplish anything a modern software engineering team can do, and more.

blocks.text: We believe the future of software is teams of agents working together to build, maintain, secure, and optimize software, while creators set the direction and stay in control.

inlines.text: We believe the future of software is teams of agents working together to build, maintain, secure, and optimize software, while creators set the direction and stay in control.

blocks.text: Over the past six months, we’ve launched industry-leading systems for black box security scanning, growth, and now production monitoring. These are important steps toward autonomous agent teams that can manage any app, tool, or business built on Replit.

blocks.text: All of this is in service of a simple idea: more people should be able to turn their ideas into something real. Building an app is only one part of that journey. By giving every creator access to agents that can do that work, more people can create, launch, and grow software without needing to become experts in every discipline.
